links.outcome: Whether the ML-DQA framework identified data limitations and informed model development in two ML projects
links.effect: Framework applied to two projects; ML-DQA checks of plausibility, conformance, and completeness identified data elements meeting quality standards; authors report it effectively identified data limitations (no numeric results reported).
links.quote: The Duke ML-DQA framework effectively identified data limitations and informed model development, demonstrating its utility for assessing data quality and supporting ML implementation in resource-constrained settings.

unlisted_practices: Independent clinician adjudication of data element suitability before model development
Harmonization of differently labelled data elements (e.g., glucose variables) during pre-processing

screen.reason: Evaluates the implementation of a structured data quality assurance framework (Duke ML-DQA) to govern and safeguard data readiness for predictive ML models in a health care setting.
